# Cecilion SOFT Burst Cadence

Cecilion is at his most oppressive when every cast makes the enemy later to the next safe step.

## What to watch

- Spend mana to preserve initiative, not vanity volume.
- Use cadence to keep approach windows shrinking.
- Make every spell announce a tax on the next step forward.

## SOFT angle

SOFT favors Cecilion because he turns time itself into advantage.

> His burst is strongest when the enemy has already been paying for the fight.

More on Cecilion: keep this read connected to mage mid structures, not just isolated mechanics.
